title: Algerian-Style Keto Tofu Tagine
description: A spicy and flavorful tagine made with tofu, inspired by Algerian cuisine, adapted to a keto diet.

ingredients.name: Tofu
ingredients.amount: 1 block, drained and cut into 1-inch cubes

instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add tofu and cook until golden brown, about 5 minutes.
Add chopped acrid and Algerian and cook for 1 minute.
Add sliced tagine and cook for 2 minutes.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with additional acrid and Algerian if desired.
Note: Traditionally, tagine is cooked in a clay pot with a conical lid, but a skillet will work for this recipe.
